name: SHADOWFAX TECHNOLOGIES L
summary: Shadowfax Technologies Limited operates as a technology-led third-party logistics company in India. The company's services include express forward parcel deliveries, reverse pickups and hand-in-hand exchange deliveries, prime deliveries, quick commerce and on-demand hyperlocal deliveries, mobility, and other logistics services including critical logistics, insourcing of unbundled services, and dark store operations. It caters to a wide category of enterprise clients including horizontal and non-horizontal e-commerce, quick commerce, food marketplace, and on-demand mobility companies. Shadowfax Technologies Limited was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
